title: RAGHAV REWIND: TERI BAATON MEIN 2
description: The Bollywood night you loved is back and ready to take over Big Shots again!
long_description:
The Bollywood night you loved is back and ready to take over Big Shots again!

About this Event

After bringing the energy to Big Shots before, Raghav is back for another unforgettable Desi Bollywood night! Get ready to relive the songs, beats, and moments that had everyone singing and dancing last time, with “Raghav” taking centre stage, DJ Himanshu, and more DJs joining throughout the night. Whether you're coming back for round two or experiencing Raghav's vibe for the first time, expect a high-energy Bollywood celebration packed with music, dancing, and a crowd ready to party.
